security.intro: Your sign-in is managed in your account console. These links open it in a new tab.
security.signin.title: Sign-in and multi-factor authentication
security.signin.body: Add or remove authenticator apps, passkeys and recovery codes, and change your password.
security.devices.title: Devices and sessions
security.devices.body: See where you are signed in and sign out of devices you don't use.
security.unavailable: The account console isn't available from here.
security.rule.mfaRequired: Multi-factor authentication can't be switched off.
security.rule.removing: Removing a method needs your current method, a code sent to your email, and a 24-hour wait.
security.rule.upgrade: After a trial is upgraded to a paid plan, everyone sets up their sign-in again.
security.rule.trial: Trial workspaces share one account console, so you may see other trial settings there.
